## Exercise 1

```{r}
json = '
{
  "firstName": "John",
  "lastName": "Smith",
  "age": 25,
  "address":
  {
    "streetAddress": "21 2nd Street",
    "city": "New York",
    "state": "NY",
    "postalCode": 10021
  },
  "phoneNumber":
  [ {
      "type": "home",
      "number": "212 555-1239"
    },
    {
      "type": "fax",
      "number": "646 555-4567"
  } ]
}
'

j2 = jsonlite::fromJSON(json, simplifyVector = FALSE) 

```

```{r}
list(
  "firstName" = "John",
  "lastName" = "Smith",
  "age" = 25,
  "address" =
  list(
    "streetAddress" = "21 2nd Street",
    "city" = "New York",
    "state" = "NY",
    "postalCode" = 10021
  ),
  "phoneNumber" =
  list( list(
      "type" = "home",
      "number" = "212 555-1239"
    ),
    list(
      "type" = "fax",
      "number" = "646 555-4567"
  ) )
) |>
  str()
```
